notes: The manual gives no exact columns. The LED anode goes in column 1 on the top (left of ravine) half, and the cathode in column 1 on the bottom half, as the manual says 'row 1' on both sides of the ravine.
The resistor's first leg shares the LED cathode's strip (1b). Its other leg goes in free column 5 on the same side, an arbitrary choice. The GND wire male end goes in the same strip (5b).
The 3V3 wire's male end goes in the LED anode strip (1t) on the left side of the ravine.
The catalogue rpi-4b lists only GPIO_HEADER as a header port. The 3V3 and GND header pins are used as port names here, as the task instructions suggest.
The jumper wire's 'a' end is the male end (into the breadboard) and 'b' is the female end (onto the Pi pin).
The Pi is assumed to be powered on and the LED orientation (long leg = anode) is as described.
